name: Sad City 42
source:
Learn the story of a simple Russian guy Vlad, who became a Master. The Dungeon Master.
Vlad lives in Russia, in his country to such people as he treated badly. He wanted to be a good guy, but life was a strange thing and everyone was in the way.
This is a story about good and evil, about love and about the relationship between Vlad and the Russian outback.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/771130/]Steam[/url]]
